title: Authors’ Response
html: We thank the Dr. Pitak-Arnnop for the thoughtful comments on our case report. Although we agree with the important point that filler-related nodules should not be routinely excised when the diagnosis and injected material are known, our patient sought treatment because of a chief concern that required surgical removal of the nodules. She had persistent, symptomatic, firm, nonmobile white nodules of the lower labial mucosa interfering with her ability to function. The filler type, brand, and volume were unknown, and records from the injecting provider were unavailable.
